tx:
Court summons can be obtained through a variety of means:
• Monster drops
• Pickpocketing
• Randomly from caskets (obtained from big net fishing and Managing Miscellania, among other sources)
• As a reward from reward casket (hard), reward casket (elite), and puzzle casket (elite) in Treasure Trails
• As a reward from the Giant Oyster
• As a reward from Treasure turtle
▸ Pickpocketing
The following table outlines suggested monsters that can reward a court summons when pickpocketed. This is not an exhaustive list.
▸ Strategies
• Caskets — Purchasable from the Grand Exchange, this is potentially the quickest method of obtaining a court summons, with a drop rate of 5/128. Each casket will cost the player coins, with an average cost per summons of coins.
• Hill giants — Can be killed quickly by players with medium level combat skills. They drop court summons relatively often. Large numbers can be found within the Edgeville dungeon and resource dungeon.
• Pickpocketing — Players with a medium Thieving level will rarely be caught pickpocketing Al Kharid warriors. It is suggested to equip a bow without arrows, or a weapon which prevents attacking, such as the Sculpting chisel to avoid entering combat against your Thieving target. Knights of Ardougne should be considered for players above level 70 Thieving.
